title: LLM Agents Already Know When to Call Tools -- Even Without Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2605.09252v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Tool-augmented LLM agents tend to call tools indiscriminately, even when the model can answer directly. Each unnecessary call wastes API fees and latency, yet no existing benchmark systematically studies when a tool call is actually needed. We propose When2Tool, a benchmark of 18 environments (15 single-hop, 3 multi-hop) spanning three categories of tool necessity -- computational scale, knowledge boundaries, and execution reliability -- each with controlled difficulty levels that create a clear decision boundary between tool-necessary and tool-unnecessary tasks. We evaluate two families of training-free baselines: Prompt-only (varying the prompt to discourage unnecessary calls) and Reason-then-Act (requiring the model to reason about tool necessity before acting). Both provide limited control: Prompt-only suppresses necessary calls alongside unnecessary ones, and Reason-then-Act still incurs a disproportionate accuracy cost on hard

translated_title: LLM智能体已经知道何时调用工具——即使无需推理
translated_abstract: 工具增强的LLM智能体倾向于不加区分地调用工具，即使模型本身可以直接回答。每次不必要的调用都会浪费API费用和延迟时间，然而目前尚无基准能系统地研究何时才真正需要工具调用。我们提出了When2Tool，一个包含18个环境（15个单跳任务、3个多跳任务）的基准，涵盖三类工具必要性维度——计算规模、知识边界和执行可靠性——每个环境都设有可控的难度级别，在需要工具与不需要工具的任务之间形成了清晰的决策边界。我们评估了两个免训练的基线方法族：仅提示法和先推理后行动法。两者提供的控制能力都有限：仅提示法在抑制不必要调用的同时也抑制了必要调用，而先推理后行动法在困难任务上仍会造成不成比例的准确率损失。
tldr: 该论文提出了When2Tool基准，首次系统研究LLM智能体何时真正需要调用工具，并发现现有的免训练方法（仅提示、先推理后行动）对工具调用决策的控制能力有限，表明模型本身就已具备判断工具必要性的潜在能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces When2Tool, a benchmark that for the first time systematically studies when LLM agents actually need to call tools, and shows that existing training-free baselines (Prompt-only and Reason-then-Act) provide limited control over tool-calling decisions, suggesting the model itself already possesses the latent ability to judge tool necessity.
